message: もう一人の天使

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. So that means she really is an acquaintance of Lolo's?」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured I'd clear that up today」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Think we'll run into her that easily?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe... no, I bet she's here again today」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Uuu~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Look, that's her」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Way too suspicious」

name: Ria
message: 「I've been wondering about her for a while, so that's what was going on~」

name: Misa
message: 「I went ahead and explained things to everyone」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Won't we just be sticking our noses where they don't belong, though?」

name: Misa
message: 「I think it's better than having her stake out the school gate like this indefinitely」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus, I'm worried about how Lolotte's doing」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, aren't you Mr. Helpful\s10」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, got a second?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Hyaaaeh\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too bad, so sad. That way's a dead end」

name: Young Girl
message: 「No way!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sorry about this. Still, it would be trouble for you too if this turned into an incident, wouldn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you think she knows Lolotte?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte knew about you, too. If I remember right, your name is--」

name: Amyrina
message: 「My name is Amyrina. U-um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「When you all crowd around me, um... it's hard to... talk...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, sorry!」

name: Misa
message: 「Does that mean you've decided to talk to us?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why do you always have to make it sound like an interrogation?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I've lived together with Lolotte ever since we were little... umm...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So you're what they call childhood friends?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Yes! We are those childhood friends, probably」
Does that mean this girl is an angel too?

name: Synn
message: 「So, Amyrina... does that mean you came here looking for Lolotte?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Y-yes...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Such deep friendship, brings a tear to my eye!」

name: Misa
message: 「Even so, it didn't seem like she was all that thrilled to see you...」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah! S-sorry... I didn't mean to...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「No, please don't mind it. After all, it's just as you say...」
Prying any further might be rude.

name: Synn
message: 「I think Lolotte will be arriving by car soon, but... will you be able to talk to her when she gets here?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I don't know about that...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Usually Loro-chan's the one who starts talking to us. It's hard to picture it the other way around」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte... has been acting like that here as well, hasn't she」
Amyrina gives a slightly brighter smile.
However, her expression quickly stiffens.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good morning, everyone♪」

name: Synn
message: 「H-huh? Lolotte... good morning」
Oh, she seems awfully energetic, though... for some reason, unlike usual, there's no car. Uncharacteristically, she's walking to school.
Which means Riesling-san isn't by her side either.

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Um... Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I don't know you!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Lolotte-san! That's no way to act toward a friend, is it!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A friend named Amyrina, well... I-I don't know anyone like that!」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte-san!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's fine! Really, it's fine, so...」
While Amyrina was holding her back, Lolotte hurriedly disappeared into the school entrance.

name: Misa
message: 「Amyrina-san! You came all this way to see her, and you're okay with her acting like that!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's fine... because I'm the one in the wrong」

name: Synn
message: 「Did you two have a fight or something?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's... well...」

name: Synn
message: 「If you don't want to talk about it, you don't have to」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I'm sorry...」
